theorems.name: ServiceWireRefinement.bytesOf_length
theorems.claim: The byte view of a slice has the slice length.
theorems.statement: ServiceWireRefinement.bytesOf_length : ∀ (s : Aeneas.Std.Slice Aeneas.Std.U8), (ServiceWireRefinement.bytesOf s).length = s.length

theorems.name: ServiceWireRefinement.depthScanAux_ge
theorems.claim: The model depth scan never reports less than the depth it has already reached.
theorems.statement: ServiceWireRefinement.depthScanAux_ge : ∀ (rest : List ℕ) (current reached : ℕ), reached ≤ NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.depthScanAux current reached rest

theorems.name: ServiceWireRefinement.scanFails_eq
theorems.claim: The early-exit scan the generated loop performs fails exactly when the model scan exceeds the limit, from any reached depth within the limit.
theorems.statement: ServiceWireRefinement.scanFails_eq : ∀ (limit : ℕ) (rest : List ℕ) (current reached : ℕ), reached ≤ limit → ServiceWireRefinement.scanFails limit current rest = decide (limit < NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.depthScanAux current reached rest)

theorems.name: ServiceWireRefinement.depthExceeds_eq_scanFails
theorems.claim: The model depth check equals the early-exit scan started at depth zero.
theorems.statement: ServiceWireRefinement.depthExceeds_eq_scanFails : ∀ (limit : ℕ) (bytes : List ℕ), NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.depthExceeds limit bytes = ServiceWireRefinement.scanFails limit 0 bytes

theorems.name: ServiceWireRefinement.utf8EncodeChar_ascii
theorems.claim: Every byte below 128 encodes to itself as one UTF-8 byte.
theorems.statement: ServiceWireRefinement.utf8EncodeChar_ascii : ∀ n < 128, String.utf8EncodeChar (Char.ofNat n) = [UInt8.ofNat n]

theorems.name: ServiceWireRefinement.flatMap_ascii
theorems.claim: UTF-8 encoding of ASCII characters is the byte list itself.
theorems.statement: ServiceWireRefinement.flatMap_ascii : ∀ (bytes : List ℕ), (∀ n ∈ bytes, n < 128) → List.flatMap String.utf8EncodeChar (List.map Char.ofNat bytes) = List.map UInt8.ofNat bytes

theorems.name: ServiceWireRefinement.ascii_bytes_are_valid_utf8
theorems.claim: An all-ASCII byte list is valid UTF-8.
theorems.statement: ServiceWireRefinement.ascii_bytes_are_valid_utf8 : ∀ (bytes : List ℕ), (∀ n ∈ bytes, n < 128) → { data := (List.map UInt8.ofNat bytes).toArray }.IsValidUTF8

theorems.name: ServiceWireRefinement.from_utf8_ascii
theorems.claim: The external from_utf8 model accepts an all-ASCII slice unchanged.
theorems.statement: ServiceWireRefinement.from_utf8_ascii : ∀ (value : Aeneas.Std.Slice Aeneas.Std.U8), (∀ n ∈ ServiceWireRefinement.bytesOf value, n < 128) → noble_kernel.core.str.converts.from_utf8 value = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok value)

theorems.name: ServiceWireRefinement.bytesOf_drop
theorems.claim: Dropping a prefix of the byte view exposes the next slice element.
theorems.statement: ServiceWireRefinement.bytesOf_drop : ∀ (bytes : Aeneas.Std.Slice Aeneas.Std.U8) (index : ℕ) (hlt : index < bytes.length), List.drop index (ServiceWireRefinement.bytesOf bytes) = ↑(↑bytes)[index] :: List.drop (index + 1) (ServiceWireRefinement.bytesOf bytes)

theorems.name: ServiceWireRefinement.bytesOf_drop_length
theorems.claim: Dropping the whole slice leaves no bytes.
theorems.statement: ServiceWireRefinement.bytesOf_drop_length : ∀ (bytes : Aeneas.Std.Slice Aeneas.Std.U8), List.drop bytes.length (ServiceWireRefinement.bytesOf bytes) = []

theorems.name: ServiceWireRefinement.saturating_sub_one_val
theorems.claim: Saturating subtraction of one from a u32 is truncated natural subtraction.
theorems.statement: ServiceWireRefinement.saturating_sub_one_val : ∀ (x : Aeneas.Std.U32), ↑(Aeneas.Std.core.num.U32.saturating_sub x 1#u32) = ↑x - 1

theorems.name: ServiceWireRefinement.check_depth_eq
theorems.claim: For every configured depth up to four, the generated depth check returns DepthLimit exactly when the model scan exceeds that depth, and Ok otherwise.
theorems.statement: ServiceWireRefinement.check_depth_eq : ∀ (bytes : Aeneas.Std.Slice Aeneas.Std.U8) (limit : Aeneas.Std.U32), ↑limit ≤ 4 → noble_kernel.dataspace.wire.check_depth bytes limit = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (if ServiceWireRefinement.scanFails (↑limit) 0 (ServiceWireRefinement.bytesOf bytes) = true then Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Err noble_kernel.dataspace.Error.DepthLimit else Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok ())

theorems.name: ServiceWireRefinement.prefix_bytes
theorems.claim: The generated ten-byte prefix constant is the model record prefix.
theorems.statement: ServiceWireRefinement.prefix_bytes : List.map (fun x => ↑x) ↑(Aeneas.Std.Array.make 10#usize [60#u8, 115#u8, 101#u8, 114#u8, 118#u8, 105#u8, 99#u8, 101#u8, 32#u8, 34#u8] ⋯) = NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.recordPrefix

theorems.name: ServiceWireRefinement.take_succ_of_lt
theorems.claim: Taking one more element appends the element at that index.
theorems.statement: ServiceWireRefinement.take_succ_of_lt : ∀ (l : List ℕ) (index : ℕ) (hlt : index < l.length), List.take (index + 1) l = List.take index l ++ [l[index]]

theorems.name: ServiceWireRefinement.has_service_prefix_eq
theorems.claim: On every slice of at least ten bytes, the generated prefix check returns whether the first ten bytes are the model prefix.
theorems.statement: ServiceWireRefinement.has_service_prefix_eq : ∀ (bytes : Aeneas.Std.Slice Aeneas.Std.U8), 10 ≤ bytes.length → noble_kernel.dataspace.wire.has_service_prefix bytes = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (decide (List.take 10 (ServiceWireRefinement.bytesOf bytes) = NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.recordPrefix))

theorems.name: ServiceWireRefinement.take_all
theorems.claim: Taking at least the whole list returns the list.
theorems.statement: ServiceWireRefinement.take_all : ∀ (l : List ℕ) (n : ℕ), l.length ≤ n → List.take n l = l

theorems.name: ServiceWireRefinement.valid_name_eq
theorems.claim: On every string, the generated name check returns the model validName of its bytes.
theorems.statement: ServiceWireRefinement.valid_name_eq : ∀ (label : Aeneas.Std.Str), noble_kernel.dataspace.wire.valid_name label = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.validName (ServiceWireRefinement.bytesOf label))

theorems.name: ServiceWireRefinement.encode_take
theorems.claim: The first ten bytes of every model encoding are the record prefix.
theorems.statement: ServiceWireRefinement.encode_take : ∀ (label : List ℕ) (ready : Bool), List.take 10 (NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.encode label ready) = NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.recordPrefix

theorems.name: ServiceWireRefinement.encode_suffix
theorems.claim: The last five bytes of every model encoding are the readiness suffix.
theorems.statement: ServiceWireRefinement.encode_suffix : ∀ (label : List ℕ) (ready : Bool), List.drop ((NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.encode label ready).length - 5) (NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.encode label ready) = NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.recordSuffix ready

theorems.name: ServiceWireRefinement.encode_middle
theorems.claim: The bytes between the prefix and the suffix of a model encoding are its name.
theorems.statement: ServiceWireRefinement.encode_middle : ∀ (label : List ℕ) (ready : Bool), ServiceWireRefinement.recordMiddle (NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.encode label ready) = label

theorems.name: ServiceWireRefinement.split_record
theorems.claim: A list of at least fifteen bytes is its first ten bytes, its middle and its last five bytes.
theorems.statement: ServiceWireRefinement.split_record : ∀ (bytes : List ℕ), 15 ≤ bytes.length → bytes = List.take 10 bytes ++ ServiceWireRefinement.recordMiddle bytes ++ List.drop (bytes.length - 5) bytes

theorems.name: ServiceWireRefinement.encode_of_shape
theorems.claim: A list with the record prefix and a readiness suffix is the model encoding of its middle.
theorems.statement: ServiceWireRefinement.encode_of_shape : ∀ (bytes : List ℕ) (ready : Bool), 15 ≤ bytes.length → List.take 10 bytes = NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.recordPrefix → List.drop (bytes.length - 5) bytes = NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.recordSuffix ready → NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.encode (ServiceWireRefinement.recordMiddle bytes) ready = bytes

theorems.name: ServiceWireRefinement.suffix_of_encoding
theorems.claim: Bytes equal to a model encoding end with that encoding suffix.
theorems.statement: ServiceWireRefinement.suffix_of_encoding : ∀ (bytes label : List ℕ) (ready : Bool), NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.encode label ready = bytes → List.drop (bytes.length - 5) bytes = NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.recordSuffix ready

theorems.name: ServiceWireRefinement.validName_ascii
theorems.claim: Every byte of a valid name is ASCII.
theorems.statement: ServiceWireRefinement.validName_ascii : ∀ (label : List ℕ), NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.validName label = true → ∀ n ∈ label, n < 128

theorems.name: ServiceWireRefinement.bytesOf_slice_drop
theorems.claim: The byte view commutes with dropping a slice prefix.
theorems.statement: ServiceWireRefinement.bytesOf_slice_drop : ∀ (bytes : Aeneas.Std.Slice Aeneas.Std.U8) (start : Aeneas.Std.Usize), ServiceWireRefinement.bytesOf (bytes.drop start) = List.drop (↑start) (ServiceWireRefinement.bytesOf bytes)

theorems.name: ServiceWireRefinement.index_from
theorems.claim: Range-from indexing within the slice length returns the dropped slice.
theorems.statement: ServiceWireRefinement.index_from : ∀ (bytes : Aeneas.Std.Slice Aeneas.Std.U8) (start : Aeneas.Std.Usize), ↑start ≤ bytes.length → Aeneas.Std.core.slice.index.Slice.index (Aeneas.Std.core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeFromUsizeSlice Aeneas.Std.U8) bytes { start := start } = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (bytes.drop start)

theorems.name: ServiceWireRefinement.index_range
theorems.claim: Ordered in-bounds range indexing returns a slice whose bytes are the selected window.
theorems.statement: ServiceWireRefinement.index_range : ∀ (bytes : Aeneas.Std.Slice Aeneas.Std.U8) (start stop : Aeneas.Std.Usize), ↑start ≤ ↑stop → ↑stop ≤ bytes.length → ∃ part, Aeneas.Std.core.slice.index.Slice.index (Aeneas.Std.core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice Aeneas.Std.U8) bytes { start := start, «end» := stop } = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok part ∧ ServiceWireRefinement.bytesOf part = List.take (↑stop - ↑start) (List.drop (↑start) (ServiceWireRefinement.bytesOf bytes))

theorems.name: ServiceWireRefinement.index_usize_eq
theorems.claim: In-bounds element indexing returns the element of the slice list.
theorems.statement: ServiceWireRefinement.index_usize_eq : ∀ (v : Aeneas.Std.Slice Aeneas.Std.U8) (k : Aeneas.Std.Usize) (i : ℕ), ↑k = i → ∀ (l : List Aeneas.Std.U8), ↑v = l → ∀ (hk : i < l.length), v.index_usize k = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok l[i]

theorems.name: ServiceWireRefinement.five_cases
theorems.claim: A list of five bytes is a five-element literal.
theorems.statement: ServiceWireRefinement.five_cases : ∀ (l : List Aeneas.Std.U8), l.length = 5 → ∃ a b c d e, l = [a, b, c, d, e]

theorems.name: ServiceWireRefinement.from_utf8_cases
theorems.claim: The external from_utf8 model returns its input or reports invalid UTF-8.
theorems.statement: ServiceWireRefinement.from_utf8_cases : ∀ (value : Aeneas.Std.Slice Aeneas.Std.U8), noble_kernel.core.str.converts.from_utf8 value = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok value) ∨ noble_kernel.core.str.converts.from_utf8 value = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Err noble_kernel.core.str.error.Utf8Error.Invalid)

theorems.name: ServiceWireRefinement.prefix_len
theorems.claim: The generated prefix slice has length ten.
theorems.statement: ServiceWireRefinement.prefix_len : (Aeneas.Std.Array.make 10#usize [60#u8, 115#u8, 101#u8, 114#u8, 118#u8, 105#u8, 99#u8, 101#u8, 32#u8, 34#u8] ⋯).to_slice.len = 10#usize

theorems.name: ServiceWireRefinement.suffix_len
theorems.claim: The generated suffix slice has length five.
theorems.statement: ServiceWireRefinement.suffix_len : (Aeneas.Std.Array.make 5#usize [34#u8, 32#u8, 35#u8, 116#u8, 62#u8] ⋯).to_slice.len = 5#usize

theorems.name: ServiceWireRefinement.ite_ok_decide
theorems.claim: A guarded boolean computation is the decision of the conjunction.
theorems.statement: ServiceWireRefinement.ite_ok_decide : ∀ (p q : Prop) [inst : Decidable p] [inst_1 : Decidable q], (if p then Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (decide q) else Aeneas.Std.Result.ok false) = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (decide (p ∧ q))

theorems.name: ServiceWireRefinement.decode_after_checks
theorems.claim: Past the byte budget, the configured depth and the depth scan, the model decides schema or accepts.
theorems.statement: ServiceWireRefinement.decode_after_checks : ∀ (bytes : List ℕ) (configured : ℕ), bytes.length ≤ NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.maxWireBytes → 1 ≤ configured ∧ configured ≤ NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.maxWireDepth → NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.depthExceeds configured bytes = false → NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.decode bytes configured = NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.Decision.schema ∨ ∃ label ready, NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.decode bytes configured = NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.Decision.accepted label ready

theorems.name: ServiceWireRefinement.schema_of_refuted
theorems.claim: Past those checks, the model decides schema unless the bytes are the encoding of a valid name.
theorems.statement: ServiceWireRefinement.schema_of_refuted : ∀ (bytes : List ℕ) (configured : ℕ), bytes.length ≤ NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.maxWireBytes → 1 ≤ configured ∧ configured ≤ NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.maxWireDepth → NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.depthExceeds configured bytes = false → (∀ (label : List ℕ) (ready : Bool), NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.validName label = true → NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.encode label ready = bytes → False) → NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.decode bytes configured = NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.Decision.schema

theorems.name: ServiceWireRefinement.accepted_of_shape
theorems.claim: Past an allowed configured depth, a record with the prefix, a readiness suffix and a valid middle is accepted with that middle.
theorems.statement: ServiceWireRefinement.accepted_of_shape : ∀ (bytes : List ℕ) (configured : ℕ) (ready : Bool), 1 ≤ configured ∧ configured ≤ NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.maxWireDepth → 15 ≤ bytes.length → List.take 10 bytes = NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.recordPrefix → List.drop (bytes.length - 5) bytes = NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.recordSuffix ready → NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.validName (ServiceWireRefinement.recordMiddle bytes) = true → NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.decode bytes configured = NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.Decision.accepted (ServiceWireRefinement.recordMiddle bytes) ready

theorems.name: ServiceWireRefinement.min_service_bytes
theorems.claim: The generated minimum record length is fifteen bytes.
theorems.statement: ServiceWireRefinement.min_service_bytes : ↑noble_kernel.dataspace.wire.decode_service.MIN_SERVICE_BYTES = 15

theorems.name: ServiceWireRefinement.decode_service_refines
theorems.claim: For every byte slice and every configured depth, the generated decoder returns, and its result read through observed is the model decision.
theorems.statement: ServiceWireRefinement.decode_service_refines : ∀ (bytes : Aeneas.Std.Slice Aeneas.Std.U8) (configured : Aeneas.Std.U32), ∃ r, noble_kernel.dataspace.wire.decode_service bytes configured = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok r ∧ ServiceWireRefinement.observed r = some (NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.decode (ServiceWireRefinement.bytesOf bytes) ↑configured)

theorems.name: ServiceWireRefinement.decode_service_total
theorems.claim: The generated decoder returns on every input: no panic, failed bound check or divergence.
theorems.statement: ServiceWireRefinement.decode_service_total : ∀ (bytes : Aeneas.Std.Slice Aeneas.Std.U8) (configured : Aeneas.Std.U32), ∃ r, noble_kernel.dataspace.wire.decode_service bytes configured = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok r

theorems.name: ServiceWireRefinement.decode_service_accepts_iff
theorems.claim: The generated decoder returns a value with given name bytes and readiness exactly when the model accepts them.
theorems.statement: ServiceWireRefinement.decode_service_accepts_iff : ∀ (bytes : Aeneas.Std.Slice Aeneas.Std.U8) (configured : Aeneas.Std.U32) (label : List ℕ) (ready : Bool), (∃ value, noble_kernel.dataspace.wire.decode_service bytes configured = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok value) ∧ ServiceWireRefinement.bytesOf value.name = label ∧ value.ready = ready) ↔ NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.decode (ServiceWireRefinement.bytesOf bytes) ↑configured = NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.Decision.accepted label ready

theorems.name: ServiceWireRefinement.decode_service_refuses_iff
theorems.claim: The generated decoder returns ByteLimit, DepthLimit or Schema exactly when the model decides that class.
theorems.statement: ServiceWireRefinement.decode_service_refuses_iff : ∀ (bytes : Aeneas.Std.Slice Aeneas.Std.U8) (configured : Aeneas.Std.U32), (noble_kernel.dataspace.wire.decode_service bytes configured = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Err noble_kernel.dataspace.Error.ByteLimit) ↔ NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.decode (ServiceWireRefinement.bytesOf bytes) ↑configured = NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.Decision.byteLimit) ∧ (noble_kernel.dataspace.wire.decode_service bytes configured = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Err noble_kernel.dataspace.Error.DepthLimit) ↔ NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.decode (ServiceWireRefinement.bytesOf bytes) ↑configured = NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.Decision.depthLimit) ∧ (noble_kernel.dataspace.wire.decode_service bytes configured = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Err noble_kernel.dataspace.Error.Schema) ↔ NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.decode (ServiceWireRefinement.bytesOf bytes) ↑configured = NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.Decision.schema)

theorems.name: ServiceWireRefinement.decode_service_of_encode
theorems.claim: Every model encoding of a valid name decodes through the generated decoder to that name and readiness under every allowed configured depth.
theorems.statement: ServiceWireRefinement.decode_service_of_encode : ∀ (bytes : Aeneas.Std.Slice Aeneas.Std.U8) (configured : Aeneas.Std.U32) (label : List ℕ) (ready : Bool), NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.validName label = true → 1 ≤ ↑configured ∧ ↑configured ≤ NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.maxWireDepth → ServiceWireRefinement.bytesOf bytes = NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.encode label ready → ∃ value, noble_kernel.dataspace.wire.decode_service bytes configured = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok value) ∧ ServiceWireRefinement.bytesOf value.name = label ∧ value.ready = ready

theorems.name: ServiceWireRefinement.decode_service_accepted_is_canonical
theorems.claim: Every value the generated decoder accepts has a valid name and the input bytes are exactly its model encoding.
theorems.statement: ServiceWireRefinement.decode_service_accepted_is_canonical : ∀ (bytes : Aeneas.Std.Slice Aeneas.Std.U8) (configured : Aeneas.Std.U32) (value : noble_kernel.dataspace.wire.ServiceRef), noble_kernel.dataspace.wire.decode_service bytes configured = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok value) → NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.validName (ServiceWireRefinement.bytesOf value.name) = true ∧ NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.encode (ServiceWireRefinement.bytesOf value.name) value.ready = ServiceWireRefinement.bytesOf bytes

specification.name: ServiceWireRefinement.bytesOf
specification.printed: def ServiceWireRefinement.bytesOf : Aeneas.Std.Slice Aeneas.Std.U8 → List ℕ := fun s => List.map (fun x => ↑x) ↑s

specification.name: ServiceWireRefinement.scanFails
specification.printed: def ServiceWireRefinement.scanFails : ℕ → ℕ → List ℕ → Bool := fun limit x x_1 => List.brecOn (motive := fun x => ℕ → Bool) x_1 (ServiceWireRefinement.scanFails._f limit) x

specification.name: ServiceWireRefinement.recordMiddle
specification.printed: def ServiceWireRefinement.recordMiddle : List ℕ → List ℕ := fun bytes => List.take (bytes.length - 15) (List.drop 10 bytes)

specification.name: ServiceWireRefinement.observed
specification.printed: def ServiceWireRefinement.observed : Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result noble_kernel.dataspace.wire.ServiceRef noble_kernel.dataspace.Error → Option NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.Decision := fun x => match x with | Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok value => some (NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.Decision.accepted (ServiceWireRefinement.bytesOf value.name) value.ready) | Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Err noble_kernel.dataspace.Error.ByteLimit => some NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.Decision.byteLimit | Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Err noble_kernel.dataspace.Error.DepthLimit => some NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.Decision.depthLimit | Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Err noble_kernel.dataspace.Error.Schema => some NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.Decision.schema | Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Err a => none

mutation_controls.removes: a record of exactly 64 bytes is no longer within the wire budget
a zero configured depth is refused as a depth error
a closing angle bracket lowers the scanned depth
the record prefix spells service in lower case
an underscore is a name byte
the closing quote of the name is a double quote

scope: Universal theorems over the checked-in generated ServiceRef decoder: for every byte slice and every configured depth it returns, and the decision it returns, read through observed, equals NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.decode; totality, exact acceptance, exact refusal classes, decoding of every valid model encoding and canonical-only acceptance follow.
